name: blinding-orb-opponent-puts-two-cards-into-memory-class-bonus-draws
notes: Blinding Orb: banish it, the opponent puts two cards from hand into memory, and with the Class Bonus the activator draws. Pre-fix the opponent's cards were moved for an undefined player and never reached their memory.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Each opponent puts two cards from their hand into their memory. Class Bonus: Draw a card.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The ActivateAbility-1/2 handlers called MZMove($opponent, ...) with $opponent defined only in the ability body (null in the handler), so the opponent's two cards never moved. The ability and handlers are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php using the decision's own $player.
